statement: AMD says ROCm.AI is now generally available, while the new ROCm CLI component is a Technology Preview, with support for vLLM, SGLang and Megatron-LM.
why: Software maturity and framework coverage are the usual blocker to using AMD accelerators, so general availability marks a step toward a workable alternative to the incumbent GPU stack; the preview status of the CLI shows the stack is not fully finished.

impact.mechanism: A more usable open GPU software stack lowers the switching cost for buyers, adding alternative accelerator supply to the market.

confidence.basis: Vendor announcement only, no customer adoption evidence and no shipment or revenue guidance in the document.
